info.title: FreeDataExportsCMD
info.description: A .NET tool that converts piped CSV or TSV data into XLSX or ODS spreadsheets using FreeDataExportsv2.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Convert CSV or TSV piped on stdin into an .xlsx or .ods spreadsheet.

options.name: --input
options.description: Read CSV/TSV from a file instead of stdin.

options.name: --output
options.description: Full output file path, or a directory path.

options.name: --path
options.description: Directory where the spreadsheet will be saved. Defaults to current directory.

options.name: --name
options.description: Spreadsheet file name. Extension is optional. Defaults to export.

options.name: --format
options.description: Spreadsheet format. Defaults to xlsx unless --name/--output ends in .ods.

options.name: --sheetname
options.description: Worksheet tab name. Defaults to Data.

options.name: --createdby
options.description: Creator metadata written to the spreadsheet. Defaults to FreeDataExportsCMD.

options.name: --includeheader
options.description: Format the first input row as a header row. Defaults to true.

options.name: --noheader
options.description: Do not format the first input row as a header row.
